scientific_integrity: The existing exact synthesis constant and exact-extremizer classification are credited to Iosevich–Li–Yu. Clarkson and Ball–Carlen–Lieb/Ricard–Xu inequalities are cited as prior analytical inputs. Finite tests supplement the mathematical proof. No independence claim.
scientific_limitations: The numerical constants for r ≠ 2 are not claimed sharp; only small-deficit powers are sharp uniformly. Bound is measured in Fourier counting ℓ^r and requires finite affine transitivity, 1<r<∞. General projection-stability literature remains a bibliographic novelty risk.
title: Dimension-free, exponent-optimal stability for affine-transitive Fourier synthesis
